name: third-party.desktop-runtime
description: Curated provider manifest for the desktop.runtime capability.

source.upstreamOwner: Desktop runtime maintainers and the project under test
source.upstreamSource: Electron, Tauri, native app commands or project-provided desktop run scripts

desktop.runtime.fallback: Manual desktop app launch with logs, screenshots and project-specific reproduction notes.

install.method: Use the desktop project's existing runtime command and dependencies; this provider records the capability contract.
uninstall: Remove this provider plugin from the AgentRig install set; uninstall runtime dependencies through the owning project if needed.

filesystem: App logs and temporary runtime data
network: Local development servers or app endpoints declared by the project
permissions.approval: Human approval required before launching production-connected apps or commands that alter local user data.

transport.notes: Project-owned desktop runtime command; wrapper does not define the app framework.

security.notes: Desktop runtimes execute local project code and may access OS resources. Use project-scoped commands and visible approval.

risk.notes: Launching desktop apps can execute local code, access user files or connect to external services.
